system.description: Once per turn when a creature is hit by one of your ranged weapon attacks, automatically deal (SL) damage of the attack's type to up to two other creatures within melee range; then roll a d8, and on a 2 or lower you or a willing ally also takes the full damage dealt. During your turn you may spend 10 MP to make your next Black Powder this turn deal (SL x 2) instead.
